faq.q: What is a titanium upper wishbone clevis?
faq.a: A titanium upper wishbone clevis is a precision-machined suspension component used in front upper wishbone rear leg chassis clevis (ti-6246). Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium upper wishbone clevis?
faq.a: Titanium Upper Wishbone Clevis is manufactured to ASTM F136 / ISO 5832-3 (Ti-6Al-4V ELI) or ASTM F1295 (Ti-6Al-7Nb) for medical implants. This requires oxygen <0.13%, iron <0.25%, and 100% traceability with MTC per batch.

faq.q: How is titanium upper wishbone clevis manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Upper Wishbone Clevis is manufactured using Hot forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium upper wishbone clevis?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
